entries.concern: "Semente do sorteio" is a literal botanical translation of "seed" (semente = plant seed). The catalogue itself uses the correct "cabeça de chave" in control.seeding.toggleLockAriaLabel — internally inconsistent; glossary requires "cabeça de chave".

entries.currentTranslation: Inscritos que precisam de uma abreviação
entries.concern: "Inscritos" (entrant) differs from "entrante(s)" used in zoneGroup/promotion keys and from "Participante" used in scheduleBuilder.entrantColumn — three different renderings of the same glossary term "entrant" within one catalogue.
